baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيْكُم مَّا حُمِّلْتُمْ ... وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا
baseline_models.mechanism: The passive repetition of حمل and the mirrored عليه/عليكم allocate nontransferable trusts: the sent carrier must get the message across, while the hearers must carry their response. The final إلا clause limits the messenger's load rather than making him guarantor of uptake.

activation_trace.role: A carried trust or burden supplies the load-bearing image for the mirrored assignments and makes each side answerable for its own charge.
The messenger as carrier of a carried saying identifies the content of his assigned load.
Message-delivery gives the messenger's load its terminal action: bringing the entrusted communication to its addressees.

changed_reading.before: The verse commands obedience and excuses the messenger if people refuse.
changed_reading.after: The verse establishes a custody chain with separately assigned, nontransferable accountability for conveyance and response.

baseline_models.mechanism: Three طوع forms make obedience the repeated input and guidance the conditional result. Compliance with the sent carrier aligns conduct with a conveyed direction, so هدى is realized as a course taken rather than information merely possessed.

activation_trace.role: Compliant movement under a command supplies the repeated action that the conditional clause tests.
The carrier of a message supplies the mediated direction with which conduct is to align.
Direction, course, and intended bearing make the result of obedience an enacted orientation.

changed_reading.before: Obedience is a command followed by guidance as an external reward.
changed_reading.after: Obedience is practical alignment with the conveyed course, and guidance is that alignment becoming directional life.

baseline_models.mechanism: بلوغ contributes arrival at an endpoint, while بين contributes both disclosure and separation. Clear delivery therefore does two jobs at once: it exposes the meaning and marks the point where the messenger's task ends and the audience's burden begins.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at a limit turns delivery into a completed threshold rather than indefinite responsibility for reception.
Disclosure by speech or sign supplies the intelligibility required of the delivered message.
Separation after connection supplies the role boundary produced once the message has arrived clearly.

changed_reading.before: Clear delivery means only that the messenger speaks understandably.
changed_reading.after: Clear delivery is simultaneously intelligible disclosure and a responsibility threshold separating carrier from recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby sequence places a claim of faith and obedience before enacted withdrawal, then joins hearing to compliance and rejects emphatic oaths in favor of recognizable obedience. The focus command قل أطيعوا consequently tests whether saying becomes conduct; turning away is the failed conversion from utterance to action.

activation_trace.role: Voiced utterance anchors the focus command in the domain whose truth must become externally testable.
Compliance supplies the enacted counterpart against which declarations are measured.
The possibility of saying what is not realized makes the declared obedience a claim tested by what follows.
Withdrawal and refusal provide the bodily contradiction of the preceding verbal profession.
Hearing as understanding and compliance fuses reception with execution in the faithful response.
The apportioned oath supplies the verbal intensification that the sequence explicitly refuses as a substitute for obedience.
Recognition by an identifying trace makes obedience knowable through its visible pattern rather than through oath volume.

structural_cues: 24:47 places a profession of faith and obedience immediately before a group's turning away.
24:51's quoted response joins hearing to obedience; 24:53 rejects intensified oath-speech in favor of recognizable obedience.
24:54 repeats قول, طوع, and تولي after those contrasts and then assigns the parties' loads.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired professions and withdrawals, hearing joined to compliance, and rejected oaths; I infer that the focus imperative demands verifiable enactment rather than louder profession. A live alternative is that طاعة معروفة names an ordinary commanded obedience without emphasizing recognizability.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse asks listeners to affirm obedience sincerely.
changed_reading.after: It demands that voiced allegiance cross into recognizable action; the audience's carried load is precisely that conversion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The call to God and the messenger is concretized as judgment between parties. Eagerness when the right favors them and refusal when bias is feared expose selective compliance, so what is carried عليكم includes accepting an adjudicated burden even when the outcome is not self-serving.

activation_trace.role: Submission to a command anchors the changed reading in the focus demand to obey the messenger.
Entrusted burden makes an adverse but valid ruling something the hearer may still have to carry.
A verbal summons that inclines its addressee supplies the entry into the adjudicative process.
Judgment between people specifies the institutional setting in which obedience is tested.
Open submission supplies the contrast case of parties who approach readily when the right is theirs.
Bias in judgment names the feared distortion whose suspicion is used to avoid the process.

structural_cues: 24:48 defines the summons as judgment between the parties.
24:49 contrasts submission when the right is theirs with the prior refusal.
24:50 asks whether fear of judicial bias drives the refusal, and 24:54 follows with distributed responsibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies summons, adjudication, outcome-sensitive submission, and fear of bias; I infer that the focus generalizes this episode into outcome-independent procedural obedience. The alternative is that the focus remains broader and the adjudicative case is only one instance.

changed_reading.before: Obeying the messenger is broad deference to instruction.
changed_reading.after: It includes entering a fair judgment process and carrying its result even when personal advantage is not secured.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier passages contrast evidence-backed declaration with report that floods outward and is received tongue-to-tongue without knowledge, followed by divine clarification. Against that failed speech chain, رسول plus البلاغ المبين describes entrusted, attributable transmission; the audience's load includes custody of what it repeats.

activation_trace.role: A carried saying and its authorized carrier anchor the focus in accountable transmission.
Delivering a message gives the authorized chain a defined communicative act.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign supplies the chain's clarity requirement.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the evidentiary control missing from rumor.
Speech and report spreading like overflow supplies the uncontrolled propagation mechanism.
Taking up and passing on speech supplies the receiving link in the rumor chain.
Tongue-mediated message delivery supplies a bodily relay that can operate without warranted knowledge.
Clarification after the rumor episode supplies the corrective disclosure against which clear delivery is heard.

structural_cues: The opening legal sequence requires witnessed speech, while 24:14-15 depicts report spreading and being taken up by tongues without knowledge.
24:18 closes that movement with divine clarification.
The focus combines a sent carrier, assigned load, completed delivery, and manifest disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies evidence, uncontrolled report-flow, tongue reception, and repeated clarification; I infer that البلاغ المبين carries a provenance and custody dimension as well as semantic clarity. A live alternative is that the earlier controls concern accusation alone and do not qualify every delivered message.

changed_reading.before: Clear delivery is transparent content spoken by the messenger.
changed_reading.after: It is an accountable transmission chain, contrasted with unattributed social relay, and hearers carry responsibility for downstream speech custody.

context_deltas.mechanism: The light passage supplies perceptibility, repeated بيان supplies disclosure, and the straight path supplies a traversable course. In the focus, clear delivery makes direction visible, while obedience is the act that converts visibility into navigation; exposure to clarity is not identical with walking by it.

activation_trace.role: Compliant movement anchors the transition from perceived direction to enacted course.
Direction and course make the focus result explicitly navigational.
Disclosure by speech supplies the perceptible guidance offered through delivery.
Illumination supplies the condition under which a route can be seen rather than merely named.
Gentle indication toward a road or truth joins illumination directly to guidance.
Manifest disclosure makes the signs visible immediately before the path statement.
The straight road supplies the concrete route into which the focus conditional can place the obedient hearer.

structural_cues: 24:35 joins layered light to divine guidance.
24:46 places clarifying signs, guidance, and a straight path in one sequence.
24:54 distinguishes completed clear delivery from the conditional result of obedience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies illumination, disclosure, guidance, and path; I infer a staged arrow from visibility through responsive movement to navigation. The alternative is that light and path are parallel images without a process relation.

changed_reading.before: The messenger explains clearly, after which guidance is granted.
changed_reading.after: Clear delivery renders a route perceptible, but obedient movement is what turns that perceptibility into lived guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, belief/security share one root occurrence, succession replaces one holder with another, empowerment establishes capacity, fear is exchanged for security, and communal practice is made to stand. Guidance through obedience therefore scales from individual orientation into a community capable of carrying stable public practice.

activation_trace.role: Entrusted burden anchors stable order in distributed duties rather than in passive benefit.
A settled direction or course supplies the focus result that the following public sequence expands.
Security and heart-settling trust bind the believing subject to the promised social condition.
One party coming after and standing in another's place supplies succession as transferred public responsibility.
Empowerment supplies the capacity for an entrusted way to become established practice.
One condition standing in place of another supplies the explicit fear-to-security transformation.
Rising with resolve to an undertaking makes communal worship an enacted structure rather than a verbal assent.

structural_cues: 24:55 immediately follows the focus with succession, establishment, and fear replaced by security.
24:56 turns to standing up prayer, giving alms, obeying the messenger, and the prospect of mercy.
The focus has already divided the loads before this collective outcome is described.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the immediate sequence from obedience and guidance to succession, capacity, transformed security, and standing practice; I infer that distributed obedience is a social load-bearing mechanism. The alternative is that 24:55-56 states a promise and duties without making them effects of the focus's role partition.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is primarily the hearer's correct individual direction.
changed_reading.after: Guidance also appears as a community acquiring the capacity, succession, and stable practices needed to bear a public trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing collective scene gathers people around a common matter, regulates departure by permission, and exposes quiet slipping and concealment as divergent conduct. The messenger's clear-delivery role is therefore not inert announcement: it includes communicative coordination of a shared undertaking, while participants still carry the moral load of staying, requesting leave, or evading.

activation_trace.role: The message carrier anchors coordination in the focus's mediated authority.
Compliance supplies the participant-side conduct by which common action remains coordinated.
Delivery of instruction supplies the communicative act through which procedure becomes knowable.
A firmly gathered resolve supplies the common matter that requires coordinated presence.
Permission and authorization supply the visible procedure for legitimate departure.
Quiet extraction supplies the covert bodily mechanism by which participants evade common accountability.
Hiding behind another supplies concealment as the social cover for evasion.
Taking a path different from one's companion supplies opposition as divergence from coordinated direction.

structural_cues: 24:62 defines an أمر جامع and repeats requests for permission before departure.
24:63 distinguishes the messenger's call from peer calling and depicts hidden slipping away.
The focus's limitation of the messenger's load coexists with this procedural authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies common business, authorized leave, differentiated calling, and covert evasion; I infer that clear conveyance can include procedural coordination without transferring participants' culpability to the messenger. The alternative is that these closing rules concern etiquette only and do not revise the scope of البلاغ.

changed_reading.before: The messenger's limited role is exhausted by announcing content.
changed_reading.after: His delivery can organize a shared procedure and authorize exceptions, while each participant remains accountable for compliance or evasion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cloud sequence is gently driven, accumulated, releases its payload, and is directed toward some while diverted from others. Focus branches for حمل and رسل independently include water-bearing cloud and sent rain or wind, so the messenger can be pictured as a payload carrier within a distribution process, not the owner of where reception finally settles.

activation_trace.role: A cloud carrying abundant water supplies the focus-side material image of an entrusted payload.
Sending people, winds, or rain supplies the movement of a payload away from its source.
Reaching an endpoint anchors the analogy in the focus's completed-delivery term.
Gentle driving supplies the upstream propulsion of the carrier.
Accumulation layer upon layer supplies formation and concentration of the carried payload.
Descending rain supplies the release of what the carrier held.
Turning something away from its face supplies the limit on where the released payload is received.

structural_cues: 24:43 sequences gentle cloud-driving, joining, piling, release through gaps, directed impact, and diversion.
The focus assigns a carried load to the messenger and names only completed delivery as his responsibility.
The focus conditional places guidance on responsive obedience rather than on mere arrival of the payload.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a material distribution sequence plus focus branches linking carrying and sending to rain; I supply the analogy from water payload to message payload and the arrow from diversion to non-uptake. The live alternative is that the meteorological passage is independent imagery with no communicative mapping.

changed_reading.before: The messenger transports an abstract message and is not liable for refusal.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he is a carrier that gathers and releases a life-bearing payload within a larger distribution system whose final reception he does not control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain threshold analogy, not a substitution of puberty for proclamation. It remains anchored because the same بلغ occurrence family marks the focus delivery and, in 24:58-59, arrival at maturity that changes permission duties; downstream prose should qualify it as an exploratory responsibility-transfer image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْبَلَاغُ within the mirrored عليه/عليكم load clauses

activation_trace.role: Arrival at a limit makes clear delivery a point at which one phase of responsibility can end and another begin.
Not yet reaching maturity supplies a pre-threshold condition under a limited permission regime.
Reaching maturity supplies the explicit threshold after which the subject carries a fuller permission duty.
Permission supplies the duty whose allocation depends on whether the threshold has been reached.
The renewed permission requirement supplies the post-threshold responsibility transferred to the matured subject.

changed_reading.before: بلاغ names successful delivery to the audience.
changed_reading.after: It may also image an accountability threshold: once clear communication has arrived, recipient-side responsibility comes of age.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The packet's split mapping from ه د ي to ه د د is form-distant and must not replace the ordinary guidance sense. It remains anchored in the exact focus root occurrence and gains limited support from the nearby image of judgment that prevents and repairs; downstream prose should render it only as a shadow image of social non-collapse under enacted guidance.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking and demolition supply the negative structural state against which the guidance result can cast a faint shadow.
Prevention and corrective return supply a nearby mechanism by which adjudication restrains social breakage.

changed_reading.before: تهتدوا means that obedient hearers acquire right direction.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root shadow, their guidance also keeps the burdened relation from breaking apart under refusal and mistrust.

strongest_changes: Obedience became enacted and outcome-independent submission rather than profession or oath.
The mirrored حمل clauses became a custody protocol: entrusted delivery belongs to the messenger, while uptake and conduct belong to hearers.
المبين became both disclosure and a boundary or verification operation against uncontrolled report-flow.
Light, path, post-focus order, and collective procedure expanded guidance from understood content into navigable and shared practice.
summary.what_was_special: The immediate 24:47-53 recurrence of saying, obeying, turning away, hearing, and oath-speech tightly reprogrammed the focus, while whole-surah evidence, illumination, public-order, permission, and rain mechanisms opened distinct but still focus-anchored readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the rain relay is a productive material analogy or only a coincidental branch overlap.
Whether the maturity uses of بلغ support a responsibility-transfer threshold beyond same-root resonance.
How far the collective permission scene expands the messenger's البلاغ beyond announcing content.
The ه د د split-root shadow is deliberately contained and must not be presented as the lexical meaning of تهتدوا.
